mapper.sql: conversation_id, member_a_id, member_b_id, origin_post_id, last_message_text, last_message_time, a_unread, b_unread, a_deleted, b_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from mall_chat_conversation where member_a_id = #{a} and member_b_id = #{b}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_chat_conversation (member_a_id, member_b_id, origin_post_id, a_unread, b_unread, a_deleted, b_deleted, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberAId}, #{memberBId}, #{originPostId}, 0, 0, '0', '0', now(), now())
mapper.update: update mall_chat_conversation set last_message_text = #{lastText}, last_message_time = #{lastTime}, update_time = #{lastTime}, a_unread = a_unread + (case when member_a_id = #{recipientId} then 1 else 0 end), b_unread = b_unread + (case when member_b_id = #{recipientId} then 1 else 0 end), a_deleted = '0', b_deleted = '0' where conversation_id = #{conversationId}

update mall_chat_conversation set a_unread = case when member_a_id = #{memberId} then 0 else a_unread end, b_unread = case when member_b_id = #{memberId} then 0 else b_unread end where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: select c.conversation_id as conversationId, (case when c.member_a_id = #{memberId} then c.member_b_id else c.member_a_id end) as memberId, m.nick_name as memberNickname, m.avatar_url as memberAvatar, c.last_message_text as lastMessageText, DATE_FORMAT(c.last_message_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') as lastMessageTime, (case when c.member_a_id = #{memberId} then c.a_unread else c.b_unread end) as unread, c.origin_post_id as originPostId from mall_chat_conversation c left join mall_member m on m.member_id = (case when c.member_a_id = #{memberId} then c.member_b_id else c.member_a_id end) where (c.member_a_id = #{memberId} or c.member_b_id = #{memberId}) and ((c.member_a_id = #{memberId} and c.a_deleted = '0') or (c.member_b_id = #{memberId} and c.b_deleted = '0')) and c.last_message_time is not null order by c.last_message_time desc
